spirit-3-portable-oxygen-concentrator.name: SPIRIT-3 Portable Oxygen Concentrator
spirit-3-portable-oxygen-concentrator.description: The Yuwell SPIRIT-3 (SP-3) is a compact pulse-dose portable oxygen concentrator for an active, on-the-go lifestyle. It has four adjustable pulse-dose settings, a modular rechargeable battery, AC and vehicle DC power, replaceable molecular sieve beds and a protective shoulder bag. Prescription oxygen device: pulse-dose settings are not equivalent to continuous-flow L/min, and the therapy setting requires individual clinical assessment.
features: Up to 5 hours of battery runtime at setting 1
Rechargeable battery plus AC and vehicle DC power
Compact unit with a protective shoulder carry bag
Display shows the flow setting and battery level
Alerts for low oxygen, no breath/flow and faults

specs.label: Battery runtime
specs.value: Setting 1: 5 hr · 2: 3 hr 20 min · 3: 2 hr 20 min · 4: 2 hr (approximate)

specs.label: Power
specs.value: Rechargeable Li-ion battery; 100–240 V AC supply; vehicle DC

specs.label: Included
specs.value: Concentrator, Li-ion battery, AC supply, DC cable, nasal cannula, 2 filter felts, carry bag, manual

spirit-3-portable-oxygen-concentrator.warranty: 3-year warranty on the compressor; 2-year warranty on the sieve beds.
